keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Real Madrid 0, Celta Vigo 1. Pablo Durán (Celta Vigo) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Williot Swedberg.
Penalty missed. Kylian Mbappé (Real Madrid) right footed shot is too high.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Ferran Jutglà replaces Hugo Álvarez.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Federico Valverde replaces Bernardo Silva.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Marc Cucurella replaces Álvaro Carreras.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Vinícius Júnior replaces Trent Alexander-Arnold.
Goal! Real Madrid 1, Celta Vigo 1. Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Kylian Mbappé.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Couhaib Driouech replaces Hugo Burcio.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Aleix Febas replaces Williot Swedberg.
Delay in match (Real Madrid).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Endrick replaces Yan Diomande.
Yoel Lago (Celta Vigo) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Iago Aspas replaces Pablo Durán.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Javi Rueda replaces Javi Galán.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Carlos Espí replaces Eduardo Camavinga.
Javi Rodríguez (Celta Vigo) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Real Madrid 2, Celta Vigo 1. Carlos Espí (Real Madrid) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal.
Carlos Espí (Real Madrid) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
